title: pyproject declares no supported Python range
description: pyproject.toml declares a pyproject that records no `requires-python` range. Nothing states which interpreter the project supports, so a resolver can install it on a runtime its dependencies never supported.
remediation: Declare `requires-python` and keep it aligned with the runtime the project ships.
limitation: It matches a pyproject that records no `requires-python` range in the parsed pyproject.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
